<thought>Based on the ¹H NMR data, the compound shows a para‑disubstituted aromatic ring (two sets of 2 H, typical AA′BB′ pattern) and a cyclohexyl group (10 H at ~1.35 ppm and a benzylic CH at ~2.63 ppm). The total proton count (15 H) fits a formula C₁₂H₁₅F, which corresponds to a para‑fluoro‑phenyl‑cyclohexane. The SMILES for this structure is “Fc1ccc(C2CCCCC2)cc1”.</thought>
<final_answer>Fc1ccc(C2CCCCC2)cc1</final_answer>
